harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: UDP meter ingestion is repaired and persistent on node1. Valid readings append to readings.csv, duplicate meter/sequence pairs are ignored across restarts, malformed packets go to malformed.log without stopping collection, and the original west,1,42 reading remains intact. Both nodes passed sequential reboot recovery verification without changing RHEL or the kernel.
actions_performed: Replaced collector.py with a Python 3.9-compatible validated UDP collector.
Added and enabled udp-meter-collector.service with automatic restart.
Opened UDP/9098 in runtime and persistent firewalld configuration.
Tested valid, duplicate, malformed, negative, wrong-field-count, and invalid-UTF-8 datagrams from node2.
Verified collector-process restart and on-disk deduplication.
Safely restarted node1 and node2 individually, proving changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Valid datagrams append; duplicates are ignored; malformed datagrams are isolated without terminating collection
evidence.summary: Seven cross-node probes produced unique valid rows, one copy of the duplicate, four malformed-log entries, and an active collector.

evidence.requirement: Previously recorded west,1,42 survives collector restart
evidence.summary: Collector PID changed and the listener returned; disk-backed duplicate probes were ignored, a new valid row appended, and west,1,42 remained unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Persistent service, firewall access, and legacy OS/kernel compatibility
evidence.summary: Collector is enabled and active, UDP/9098 is listening and allowed persistently, and the installed RHEL 9.8 kernel remains 5.14.0-687.20.1.el9_8.x86_64.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from bef0e5ec-ce32-423b-826a-8a5a90584d3a to d55cc647-328f-4b8e-af33-873b37f48c1e; services, listener, preserved data, deduplication, valid ingestion, and malformed handling recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 9feeb0bb-6fe6-40fb-9831-d869ed07631c to 8fd9dbe0-a739-4384-94c0-6affe94b63a4; networking, sender data, node1 reachability, and post-reboot UDP delivery recovered.
